about: The simulated league with the teaching normal-normal posterior (prior mean 0). The read-out gives the fraction of the way to 0 each size moves and the pairs whose order changes; the rule table gives each size's SE, share kept, fraction moved and posterior SD; the units figure's hidden table gives each unit's estimate, posterior mean, posterior SD and (view 2) true value; the price panel gives this draw against the true values and the closed-form expectations. Ported from v1 with the keys renamed (prior_sd -> priorSd, equal_se -> equalSe: v3 preset keys are plain words), the caption in its v3 wording and the lead scoped to this draw. Posterior means, SDs and shares are rows of the base-R oracle (oracle-simulate); the fractions moved and the counts not in the oracle come from v1's frozen registry; distances, spreads and the count of units that end farther from the registry and oracle-summaries; the closed-form expected squared distance (engine expectedSquaredDistance, new in v3) from oracle-v3. Part 1 review: the expected counts of pairs against the true order print at four significant digits (88.12, 80.69, 87.45; formatExpectedCount, register CR-002), checked against the base-R oracle rows in place of the registry's one-decimal values.
